answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in quartz, verified in tundra, and oasis names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 29 submissions per epoch. That bill is paid per identity, so 37 aliases cost 153 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
